text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty: HIGH - node gpu-node-17 (us-west1-gpu-rack-3) reported KERNEL_PANIC and kubelet NotReady. Pager: infra-oncall -> Miguel.
Miguel: Acked. pulling logs now. any customer impact seen?
Priya: Seeing ~25% errors on /v1/generate for model-serving-prod-45 from eu-west1 routed via us-west1 fallback. Errors are 502/503.
Sam: Noted, console metrics show increased latency and 5xx spike on route 'text-gen/default'. Can reproduce 503 for a small sample.
Miguel: Checking node status: `kubectl get nodes gpu-node-17 -o wide` shows NotReady, kernel taint `kernel_panic=true:NoSchedule`. kubelet is flapping.
Eva: Any alert say OOM or GPU driver hang?
Miguel: Pager payload included dmesg excerpt: "[kernel] NMI: kernel panic - not syncing: GPU watchdog timeout" and repeated `gpu 0000:65:00.0: gpu hung` entries.
Priya: Affected pods: model-pod-492 (prod-45), kv-cache-sync, and a few sidecars. 3 pods on that node crashed and got stuck in CrashLoopBackOff.
Sam: Can we cordon + drain and evict? Will draining trigger cold cache/latency for the customers?
Miguel: I'm SSHing into the host to check serial console and journalctl. `ssh ops@gpu-node-17` -> connection times out. Host seems unreachable.

oncall-handler-bot: escalation: notACKed by infra-sre in 3m, paging eng-sre primary (Eva).
Eva: On it. Initiating failover for affected routes — switching traffic to model-serving-prod-45-replicas in us-west2.
Priya: Rolling route fallback now. Notifying a couple of Dedicated customers (acct-334, acct-998) about degraded capacity.
Miguel: Kernel crashdump available on BMC, filing ticket to retrieve IPMI console logs. Tailing journalctl from last boot shows repeated `kubelet: node lease lost` and `kubelet: error syncing pod`.
Sam: For mitigation: 1) mark node unschedulable 2) trigger node replacement from autoscaler group 3) reschedule critical pods to other racks. Who triggers replacement?
Miguel: I'll trigger replacement: `gcloud compute instances reset gpu-node-17 --zone=us-west1-b` (private infra wrapper) but host is not responding to API. I'll open infra ticket for manual rack techs.
Eva: In parallel I'll ramp up model fleet in us-west2 by +4 to absorb requests. Priya, pls update support channels and customer status page.
Priya: Updating status page: "Partial degradation: routing fallbacks activated for some generation requests in US; engineers investigating GPU host failure." Sending pro-active emails to impacted accounts.
incident-bot: PagerDuty: escalation to on-call lead: Sam (eng-sre). Sam acknowledged.
Sam: Confirmed routing change took effect. Error rate dropped to 6% from 25% on the critical route. Latency increased ~150ms for some requests due to cold cache.
Miguel: Remote BMC shows kernel panic at 2026-12-07 03:12:43 UTC. Posting panic logs snippet: ```kernel panic: gpu watchdog detected hang
Call Trace: ...
GPU firmware reset failed```
Eva: Looks like a driver-level issue. Any recent driver rolling or kernel updates applied to this rack?
Miguel: No scheduled updates in the last 24h. I see a thermal throttle event just before the crash: `thermal_zone0: temperature high -> 105C` then GPU errors. Could be cooling failure.
Priya: Any customer-facing errors besides 503s? Some clients reported truncated streams. Logging those to ticket #INF-5562.
Sam: Next steps: 1) open incident ticket, severity P2 for now due to partial impact 2) assign hardware team to swap node 3) coordinate deployment rollback if driver suspected 4) run model-serving health checks and rewarm caches after reschedule. Who owns the incident doc?
Miguel: I'll start the incident doc and paste initial timeline and logs. Adding Eva and Sam as responders.
Eva: Add mitigation notes: failover applied, autoscaler triggered extra replicas in us-west2, customer notifications sent. Also add follow-up: hardware replacement, investigate thermal sensors, validate driver version.
Priya: Handoff planned at 06:00 UTC to morning oncall. Miguel/Sam/Eva will add notes to the doc and include runbook steps for remediation.
Miguel: Manual rack tech contacted, ETA ~90m to physically check the node. If they confirm thermal/hardware failure, we'll decommission node and kick a new one into the pool.
Sam: I'll monitor errors and keep channel updated. If error rate creeps past 10% or a second node shows kernel panic, escalate to SEV1.
incident-bot: Incident timeline updated. Incident status: active -> mitigated (partial failover in place).
Priya: Sending summary to CSMs now. Will follow up with root cause once hardware report and kernel oops analysis are in. :thumbsup:
Miguel: Quick debug note for postmortem — capture `/var/crash/*`, dmesg, journalctl -k -b-1, ipmi sel list, and GPU driver dump.
Sam: Thanks everyone. Leaving the channel open for handoff.
Eva: Acknowledged. Handoff to morning oncall: please pick up final verification and decomm if hardware confirms.
Priya: Last update: status page shows reduced errors, customers notified. Will post RCA timeline later.
Miguel: Closing active pager for now; monitoring.
Sam: 06:00 UTC handoff logged.

oncall-handler-bot: thread archived after handoff
